payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of how hateful tweets aimed at women are detected and classified using the ParityBOT system.

claims.text: ParityBOT classifies hateful tweets directed at women in politics using a scalable model validated on public online harassment datasets.
The system collects tweets in real-time from Twitter's streaming API and analyzes them for abusive content aimed at women candidates.
ParityBOT aims to improve public discourse by responding to hateful tweets with supportive messages about women in politics.
